name: Pull-up
description: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders and pull your chin above it, then lower fully.
caution: Use a band for assistance if you cannot control the lowering. Avoid kipping while learning.

name: Archer push-up
description: Keep one arm straight and lower your body over the other arm, then switch sides.

name: Pistol squat progression
description: Squat on one leg with the other leg straight out, using support as needed.
caution: Hold a support for balance and go only as low as you can control.

name: Hollow body hold
description: Lie flat with a tight core and your arms and legs lifted slightly off the floor.

name: L-sit progression
description: Support yourself on parallel bars or the floor with your legs lifted, staying tall.

name: Wall handstand hold
description: Kick up into a handstand against a wall and hold with a tight core and glutes.
caution: Practice with a spotter or against a wall. Stop if you feel neck pain.

name: Parallel bar dip
description: Lower yourself between parallel bars until your elbows reach about 90 degrees, then press up.
caution: Shoulder strain risk. Keep the descent shallow if you feel pain at the front of the shoulder.

name: Australian pull-up
description: Under a sturdy table, pull your chest to the edge with your body straight.

name: Bodyweight squat
description: Sit back and down with your chest up, then stand by driving through your heels.

name: Forearm plank
description: Rest on your forearms with your body straight from head to heels, and hold.
